+ // Cursor Halo - Tauri Main Process
+ // ============================================================================
+ // High-performance Rust backend for native system integration
+ // Features: Global hotkeys, screen capture, context detection
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ #![cfg_attr(
+     all(not(debug_assertions), target_os = "windows"),
+     windows_subsystem = "windows"
+ )]
+ 
+ mod commands;
+ mod context;
+ 
+ use tauri::{
+     CustomMenuItem, GlobalShortcutManager, Manager, SystemTray, SystemTrayEvent, SystemTrayMenu,
+     SystemTrayMenuItem, WindowEvent,
+ };
+ 
+ fn main() {
+     // Create system tray menu
+     let quit = CustomMenuItem::new("quit".to_string(), "Quit Cursor Halo");
+     let show = CustomMenuItem::new("show".to_string(), "Show Halo");
+     let hide = CustomMenuItem::new("hide".to_string(), "Hide Halo");
+     
+     let tray_menu = SystemTrayMenu::new()
+         .add_item(show)
+         .add_item(hide)
+         .add_native_item(SystemTrayMenuItem::Separator)
+         .add_item(quit);
+ 
+     let system_tray = SystemTray::new().with_menu(tray_menu);
+ 
+     tauri::Builder::default()
+         .system_tray(system_tray)
+         .on_system_tray_event(|app, event| match event {
+             SystemTrayEvent::LeftClick { .. } =&gt; {
+                 if let Some(window) = app.get_window("main") {
+                     if window.is_visible().unwrap_or(false) {
+                         let _ = window.hide();
+                     } else {
+                         let _ = window.show();
+                         let _ = window.set_focus();
+                     }
+                 }
+             }
+             SystemTrayEvent::MenuItemClick { id, .. } =&gt; match id.as_str() {
+                 "quit" =&gt; {
+                     std::process::exit(0);
+                 }
+                 "show" =&gt; {
+                     if let Some(window) = app.get_window("main") {
+                         let _ = window.show();
+                         let _ = window.set_focus();
+                     }
+                 }
+                 "hide" =&gt; {
+                     if let Some(window) = app.get_window("main") {
+                         let _ = window.hide();
+                     }
+                 }
+                 _ =&gt; {}
+             },
+             _ =&gt; {}
+         })
+         .setup(|app| {
+             let handle = app.handle();
+             
+             // Register global shortcut: Shift+Cmd+Space (macOS) or Shift+Ctrl+Space (Windows/Linux)
+             let shortcut = "Shift+CommandOrControl+Space";
+             
+             app.global_shortcut_manager()
+                 .register(shortcut, move || {
+                     if let Some(window) = handle.get_window("main") {
+                         if window.is_visible().unwrap_or(false) {
+                             let _ = window.hide();
+                         } else {
+                             let _ = window.show();
+                             let _ = window.set_focus();
+                             // Emit event to frontend to refresh context
+                             let _ = window.emit("toggle-halo", ());
+                         }
+                     }
+                 })
+                 .expect("Failed to register global shortcut");
+ 
+             println!("✨ Cursor Halo initialized!");
+             println!("📌 Hotkey registered: {}", shortcut);
+             
+             // Initially hide the window (will show on hotkey)
+             if let Some(window) = app.get_window("main") {
+                 // Start visible for development, hide for production
+                 #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
+                 {
+                     let _ = window.show();
+                     let _ = window.open_devtools();
+                 }
+             }
+             
+             Ok(())
+         })
+         .on_window_event(|event| {
+             if let WindowEvent::CloseRequested { api, .. } = event.event() {
+                 // Hide instead of closing
+                 event.window().hide().unwrap();
+                 api.prevent_close();
+             }
+         })
+         .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![
+             commands::get_frontmost_app,
+             commands::capture_screen_region,
+             commands::execute_action,
+             commands::get_selected_text,
+             commands::run_applescript,
+         ])
+         .run(tauri::generate_context!())
+         .expect("Error while running Cursor Halo");

+ // Cursor Halo - IPC Commands
+ // ============================================================================
+ // Tauri commands exposed to the frontend via invoke()
+ // Handles: screen capture, context detection, action execution

+ /// Application context information

+ pub struct AppContext {
+     pub app_name: String,
+     pub window_title: String,
+     pub bundle_id: String,
+     pub selected_text: Option&lt;String&gt;,
+     pub context_type: String,

+ /// Get information about the frontmost application
+ #[tauri::command]
+ pub fn get_frontmost_app() -&gt; Result&lt;AppContext, String&gt; {
+     #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
+     {
+         // Use AppleScript to get frontmost app info
+         let script = r#"
+             tell application "System Events"
+                 set frontApp to first application process whose frontmost is true
+                 set appName to name of frontApp
+                 set bundleId to bundle identifier of frontApp
+                 set windowTitle to ""
+                 try
+                     set windowTitle to name of first window of frontApp
+                 end try
+                 return appName &amp; "|" &amp; bundleId &amp; "|" &amp; windowTitle
+             end tell
+         "#;
+ 
+         let output = Command::new("osascript")
+             .arg("-e")
+             .arg(script)
+             .output()
+             .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to run AppleScript: {}", e))?;
+ 
+         let result = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stdout);
+         let parts: Vec&lt;&amp;str&gt; = result.trim().split('|').collect();
+ 
+         let app_name = parts.get(0).unwrap_or(&amp;"Unknown").to_string();
+         let bundle_id = parts.get(1).unwrap_or(&amp;"").to_string();
+         let window_title = parts.get(2).unwrap_or(&amp;"").to_string();
+ 
+         // Determine context type based on app
+         let context_type = match app_name.to_lowercase().as_str() {
+             s if s.contains("finder") =&gt; "file_manager",
+             s if s.contains("safari") || s.contains("chrome") || s.contains("firefox") || s.contains("arc") =&gt; "browser",
+             s if s.contains("code") || s.contains("cursor") || s.contains("xcode") =&gt; "code_editor",
+             s if s.contains("terminal") || s.contains("iterm") =&gt; "terminal",
+             s if s.contains("slack") || s.contains("discord") || s.contains("messages") =&gt; "messaging",
+             s if s.contains("notes") || s.contains("notion") || s.contains("obsidian") =&gt; "notes",
+             _ =&gt; "generic",
+         }.to_string();
+ 
+         Ok(AppContext {
+             app_name,
+             window_title,
+             bundle_id,
+             selected_text: None,
+             context_type,
+         })
+     }
+ 
+     #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
+     {
+         Ok(AppContext {
+             app_name: "Unknown".to_string(),
+             window_title: "".to_string(),
+             bundle_id: "".to_string(),
+             selected_text: None,
+             context_type: "generic".to_string(),
+         })
+     }
+ }

+ /// Get currently selected text (if any)
+ #[tauri::command]
+ pub fn get_selected_text() -&gt; Result&lt;Option&lt;String&gt;, String&gt; {
+     #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
+     {
+         // Try to get selected text via clipboard simulation
+         let script = r#"
+             tell application "System Events"
+                 keystroke "c" using command down
+             end tell
+             delay 0.1
+             the clipboard
+         "#;
+ 
+         let output = Command::new("osascript")
+             .arg("-e")
+             .arg(script)
+             .output()
+             .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to get selected text: {}", e))?;
+ 
+         let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stdout).trim().to_string();
+         if text.is_empty() {
+             Ok(None)
+         } else {
+             Ok(Some(text))
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
+     {
+         Ok(None)
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // SCREEN CAPTURE
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ /// Capture a region of the screen and return as base64 PNG
+ #[tauri::command]
+ pub async fn capture_screen_region(x: i32, y: i32, width: u32, height: u32) -&gt; Result&lt;String, String&gt; {
+     use screenshots::Screen;
+     use base64::{Engine as _, engine::general_purpose};
+ 
+     // Get all screens
+     let screens = Screen::all().map_err(|e| format!("Failed to get screens: {}", e))?;
+     
+     // Use primary screen (first one)
+     let screen = screens.first().ok_or("No screens found")?;
+     
+     // Capture the specified region
+     let image = screen
+         .capture_area(x, y, width, height)
+         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to capture screen: {}", e))?;
+     
+     // Convert to PNG bytes
+     let mut buffer = Vec::new();
+     let mut cursor = std::io::Cursor::new(&amp;mut buffer);
+     
+     image::DynamicImage::ImageRgba8(image.into())
+         .write_to(&amp;mut cursor, image::ImageOutputFormat::Png)
+         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to encode image: {}", e))?;
+     
+     // Encode as base64
+     let base64_string = general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&amp;buffer);
+     
+     Ok(format!("data:image/png;base64,{}", base64_string))
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // ACTION EXECUTION
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ /// Execute an action with the given payload
+ #[tauri::command]
+ pub async fn execute_action(action_id: String, payload: Option&lt;serde_json::Value&gt;) -&gt; Result&lt;ActionResult, String&gt; {
+     println!("Executing action: {} with payload: {:?}", action_id, payload);
+     
+     match action_id.as_str() {
+         "move_to_project" =&gt; {
+             // Move selected file to a project folder
+             Ok(ActionResult {
+                 success: true,
+                 message: "File moved to project".to_string(),
+                 data: None,
+             })
+         }
+         "quick_rename" =&gt; {
+             // Trigger rename dialog
+             #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
+             {
+                 let script = r#"
+                     tell application "System Events"
+                         keystroke return
+                     end tell
+                 "#;
+                 let _ = Command::new("osascript").arg("-e").arg(script).output();
+             }
+             
+             Ok(ActionResult {
+                 success: true,
+                 message: "Rename initiated".to_string(),
+                 data: None,
+             })
+         }
+         "compress_share" =&gt; {
+             // Compress selected files and prepare for sharing
+             Ok(ActionResult {
+                 success: true,
+                 message: "Files compressed".to_string(),
+                 data: None,
+             })
+         }
+         "open_with" =&gt; {
+             // Show Open With dialog
+             Ok(ActionResult {
+                 success: true,
+                 message: "Open With dialog shown".to_string(),
+                 data: None,
+             })
+         }
+         "summarize" =&gt; {
+             // AI summarization (would call AI API)
+             Ok(ActionResult {
+                 success: true,
+                 message: "Text summarized".to_string(),
+                 data: Some("This is a summarized version of the text.".to_string()),
+             })
+         }
+         "translate" =&gt; {
+             // AI translation
+             Ok(ActionResult {
+                 success: true,
+                 message: "Text translated".to_string(),
+                 data: Some("Translated text here.".to_string()),
+             })
+         }
+         _ =&gt; {
+             Ok(ActionResult {
+                 success: false,
+                 message: format!("Unknown action: {}", action_id),
+                 data: None,
+             })
+         }
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ /// Run arbitrary AppleScript (for advanced automation)
+ #[tauri::command]
+ pub fn run_applescript(script: String) -&gt; Result&lt;String, String&gt; {
+     #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
+     {
+         let output = Command::new("osascript")

+             .output()
+             .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to run AppleScript: {}", e))?;

+     }
+ 
+     #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
+     {
+         Err("AppleScript is only available on macOS".to_string())

+ }

+ /**
+  * ============================================================================
+  * CURSOR HALO - Tauri IPC Bridge
+  * ============================================================================
+  * 
+  * Frontend API for communicating with the Rust backend.
+  * Replaces Electron's preload.js with Tauri's native IPC.
+  * 
+  * ============================================================================
+  */
+ 
+ import { invoke } from '@tauri-apps/api/tauri';
+ import { listen, emit } from '@tauri-apps/api/event';
+ import { appWindow } from '@tauri-apps/api/window';
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // TYPE DEFINITIONS
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ export interface AppContext {
+   app_name: string;
+   window_title: string;
+   bundle_id: string;
+   selected_text: string | null;
+   context_type: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface CaptureRegion {
+   x: number;
+   y: number;
+   width: number;
+   height: number;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface ActionResult {
+   success: boolean;
+   message: string;
+   data: string | null;
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // CONTEXT DETECTION
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get information about the frontmost application
+  */
+ export async function getContext(): Promise&lt;AppContext&gt; {
+   try {
+     return await invoke&lt;AppContext&gt;('get_frontmost_app');
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Failed to get context:', error);
+     return {
+       app_name: 'Unknown',
+       window_title: '',
+       bundle_id: '',
+       selected_text: null,
+       context_type: 'generic',
+     };
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get currently selected text
+  */
+ export async function getSelectedText(): Promise&lt;string | null&gt; {
+   try {
+     return await invoke&lt;string | null&gt;('get_selected_text');
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Failed to get selected text:', error);
+     return null;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // SCREEN CAPTURE
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ /**
+  * Capture a region of the screen
+  * @returns Base64-encoded PNG image data URL
+  */
+ export async function captureScreenRegion(region: CaptureRegion): Promise&lt;string&gt; {
+   try {
+     return await invoke&lt;string&gt;('capture_screen_region', region);
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Failed to capture screen:', error);
+     throw error;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // ACTION EXECUTION
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ /**
+  * Execute an action with optional payload
+  */
+ export async function executeAction(
+   actionId: string,
+   payload?: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;
+ ): Promise&lt;ActionResult&gt; {
+   try {
+     return await invoke&lt;ActionResult&gt;('execute_action', {
+       action_id: actionId,
+       payload: payload || null,
+     });
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Failed to execute action:', error);
+     return {
+       success: false,
+       message: String(error),
+       data: null,
+     };
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Run arbitrary AppleScript
+  */
+ export async function runAppleScript(script: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {
+   try {
+     return await invoke&lt;string&gt;('run_applescript', { script });
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Failed to run AppleScript:', error);
+     throw error;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // WINDOW MANAGEMENT
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hide the halo window
+  */
+ export async function hideWindow(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   await appWindow.hide();
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Show the halo window
+  */
+ export async function showWindow(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   await appWindow.show();
+   await appWindow.setFocus();
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Toggle window visibility
+  */
+ export async function toggleWindow(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   const isVisible = await appWindow.isVisible();
+   if (isVisible) {
+     await hideWindow();
+   } else {
+     await showWindow();
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // EVENT LISTENERS
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ type UnlistenFn = () =&gt; void;
+ 
+ /**
+  * Listen for toggle-halo events (from global hotkey)
+  */
+ export async function onToggleHalo(callback: () =&gt; void): Promise&lt;UnlistenFn&gt; {
+   return await listen('toggle-halo', callback);
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Listen for context updates
+  */
+ export async function onContextUpdate(
+   callback: (context: AppContext) =&gt; void
+ ): Promise&lt;UnlistenFn&gt; {
+   return await listen&lt;AppContext&gt;('context-update', (event) =&gt; {
+     callback(event.payload);
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // INITIALIZATION
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ /**
+  * Initialize the Tauri API bridge
+  * Sets up event listeners and returns cleanup function
+  */
+ export async function initTauriAPI(handlers: {
+   onToggle?: () =&gt; void;
+   onContextChange?: (context: AppContext) =&gt; void;
+ }): Promise&lt;UnlistenFn[]&gt; {
+   const unlisteners: UnlistenFn[] = [];
+ 
+   if (handlers.onToggle) {
+     const unlisten = await onToggleHalo(handlers.onToggle);
+     unlisteners.push(unlisten);
+   }
+ 
+   if (handlers.onContextChange) {
+     const unlisten = await onContextUpdate(handlers.onContextChange);
+     unlisteners.push(unlisten);
+   }
+ 
+   // Initial context fetch
+   if (handlers.onContextChange) {
+     const context = await getContext();
+     handlers.onContextChange(context);
+   }
+ 
+   console.log('✨ Tauri API initialized');
+ 
+   return unlisteners;
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // FALLBACK API (for browser development without Tauri)
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ const isTauri = typeof window !== 'undefined' &amp;&amp; '__TAURI__' in window;
+ 
+ export const api = {
+   isNative: isTauri,
+   
+   getContext: isTauri ? getContext : async () =&gt; ({
+     app_name: 'Browser (Dev)',
+     window_title: document.title,
+     bundle_id: 'dev.browser',
+     selected_text: window.getSelection()?.toString() || null,
+     context_type: 'browser',
+   }),
+   
+   captureRegion: isTauri ? captureScreenRegion : async () =&gt; {

+   
+   executeAction: isTauri ? executeAction : async (actionId: string) =&gt; ({

+     message: &#96;[Dev] Would execute: ${actionId}&#96;,

+   }),
+   
+   hideWindow: isTauri ? hideWindow : async () =&gt; {

+   },
+   
+   showWindow: isTauri ? showWindow : async () =&gt; {
+     console.log('[Dev] Would show window');
+   },
+ };
+ 
+ export default api;

+   vec2 mod289(vec2 x) { return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0; }

+   float snoise(vec2 v) {

+     vec4 x12 = x0.xyxy + C.xxzz;
+     x12.xy -= i1;
+     i = mod289(i);
+     vec3 p = permute( permute( i.y + vec3(0.0, i1.y, 1.0 ))
+         + i.x + vec3(0.0, i1.x, 1.0 ));
+     vec3 m = max(0.5 - vec3(dot(x0,x0), dot(x12.xy,x12.xy),
+         dot(x12.zw,x12.zw)), 0.0);
+     m = m*m;
+     m = m*m;
+     vec3 x = 2.0 * fract(p * C.www) - 1.0;

+     vec3 a0 = x - ox;

+     { id: 'open_with', label: 'Open With...', iconId: 'window', description: 'Choose app' },
+   ],
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get actions for a given context
+  * @param {Object} context - { appName, contextType }
+  * @returns {Array} - List of action objects
+  */
+ export function getActionsForContext(context) {
+   const { contextType = 'generic' } = context;
+   return actionsByContext[contextType] || actionsByContext.generic;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get a specific action by ID
+  * @param {string} actionId 
+  * @returns {Object|null}
+  */
+ export function getActionById(actionId) {
+   for (const actions of Object.values(actionsByContext)) {
+     const found = actions.find(a =&gt; a.id === actionId);
+     if (found) return found;
+   }
+   return null;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get all available actions
+  * @returns {Object} - Actions by context type
+  */
+ export function getAllActions() {
+   return actionsByContext;
+ }
+ 
+ export default {
+   getActionsForContext,
+   getActionById,
+   getAllActions,
+ };
+

+   IconImage,
+   IconGlobe,

+ } from './components/Icons';

+ // Check if running in Tauri
+ const isTauri = typeof window !== 'undefined' &amp;&amp; '__TAURI__' in window;

+ // App States
+ const STATES = {
+   ORB_ONLY: 'orb_only',
+   SELECTING: 'selecting',
+   EXPANDED: 'expanded',

+ 
+ // Loading fallback
+ function OrbLoader() {
+   return (
+     &lt;mesh&gt;
+       &lt;sphereGeometry args={[0.8, 32, 32]} /&gt;

+   );
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // APP SPHERE COMPONENT - Spherical app icons
+ // ============================================================================
+ function AppSphere({ name, color, icon: Icon, onClick, delay = 0 }) {
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.button
+       onClick={onClick}
+       style={sphereStyles.button}
+       initial={{ scale: 0, opacity: 0 }}
+       animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
+       transition={{ delay, type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 20 }}
+       whileHover={{ scale: 1.15, boxShadow: &#96;0 0 30px ${color}60&#96; }}
+       whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
+       title={name}
+     &gt;
+       &lt;div style={{ ...sphereStyles.sphere, background: &#96;radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, ${color}90, ${color}40)&#96;, boxShadow: &#96;0 8px 32px ${color}50, inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.3)&#96; }}&gt;
+         {Icon &amp;&amp; &lt;Icon style={sphereStyles.icon} /&gt;}
+         {!Icon &amp;&amp; &lt;span style={sphereStyles.letter}&gt;{name[0]}&lt;/span&gt;}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;span style={sphereStyles.label}&gt;{name}&lt;/span&gt;
+     &lt;/motion.button&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ const sphereStyles = {
+   button: {
+     display: 'flex',
+     flexDirection: 'column',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     gap: '8px',
+     background: 'none',
+     border: 'none',
+     cursor: 'pointer',
+     padding: '8px',
+   },
+   sphere: {

+     height: '56px',
+     borderRadius: '50%',
+     display: 'flex',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     justifyContent: 'center',
+     transition: 'all 0.3s ease',
+   },
+   icon: {
+     width: '24px',
+     height: '24px',
+     color: 'white',
+   },
+   letter: {
+     fontSize: '20px',
+     fontWeight: 700,
+     color: 'white',
+     textShadow: '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',

+     fontWeight: 500,
+     color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)',
+   },
+ };
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // DROP CANVAS COMPONENT
+ // ============================================================================
+ function DropCanvas({ onDrop, content }) {
+   const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
+   const canvasRef = useRef(null);
+ 
+   const handleDragOver = (e) =&gt; {
+     e.preventDefault();
+     setIsDragging(true);
+   };
+ 
+   const handleDragLeave = () =&gt; setIsDragging(false);
+ 
+   const handleDrop = (e) =&gt; {
+     e.preventDefault();
+     setIsDragging(false);
+     
+     const files = e.dataTransfer.files;
+     const text = e.dataTransfer.getData('text');
+     
+     if (files.length &gt; 0) {
+       onDrop({ type: 'files', data: Array.from(files) });
+     } else if (text) {
+       onDrop({ type: 'text', data: text });
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handlePaste = useCallback((e) =&gt; {
+     const items = e.clipboardData?.items;
+     if (!items) return;
+ 
+     for (const item of items) {
+       if (item.type.startsWith('image/')) {
+         const file = item.getAsFile();
+         onDrop({ type: 'image', data: file });
+       } else if (item.type === 'text/plain') {
+         item.getAsString((text) =&gt; onDrop({ type: 'text', data: text }));
+       }
+     }
+   }, [onDrop]);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     document.addEventListener('paste', handlePaste);
+     return () =&gt; document.removeEventListener('paste', handlePaste);
+   }, [handlePaste]);
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.div
+       ref={canvasRef}
+       style={{
+         ...canvasStyles.container,
+         borderColor: isDragging ? '#4ade80' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)',
+         background: isDragging ? 'rgba(74,222,128,0.1)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)',
+       }}
+       onDragOver={handleDragOver}
+       onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
+       onDrop={handleDrop}
+       initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
+       animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
+       transition={{ delay: 0.3 }}
+     &gt;
+       {content ? (
+         &lt;div style={canvasStyles.content}&gt;
+           {content.type === 'text' &amp;&amp; &lt;p style={canvasStyles.text}&gt;{content.data}&lt;/p&gt;}
+           {content.type === 'image' &amp;&amp; &lt;img src={URL.createObjectURL(content.data)} alt="Dropped" style={canvasStyles.image} /&gt;}
+           {content.type === 'files' &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div style={canvasStyles.files}&gt;
+               {content.data.map((f, i) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;div key={i} style={canvasStyles.file}&gt;
+                   &lt;IconDocument style={{ width: 16, height: 16, color: '#4ade80' }} /&gt;
+                   &lt;span&gt;{f.name}&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       ) : (
+         &lt;div style={canvasStyles.placeholder}&gt;
+           &lt;IconPlus style={{ width: 32, height: 32, color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)' }} /&gt;
+           &lt;p&gt;Drop files, images, or text here&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;span&gt;or paste from clipboard&lt;/span&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       )}
+     &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ const canvasStyles = {
+   container: {
+     width: '100%',
+     minHeight: '120px',
+     borderRadius: '16px',
+     border: '2px dashed',
+     display: 'flex',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     justifyContent: 'center',
+     transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
+     marginBottom: '16px',
+   },
+   placeholder: {
+     display: 'flex',
+     flexDirection: 'column',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     gap: '8px',
+     padding: '24px',
+     color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)',
+     fontSize: '13px',
+     textAlign: 'center',
+   },
+   content: {
+     padding: '16px',
+     width: '100%',
+   },
+   text: {
+     color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)',
+     fontSize: '14px',
+     lineHeight: 1.5,
+     margin: 0,
+   },
+   image: {
+     maxWidth: '100%',
+     maxHeight: '200px',
+     borderRadius: '8px',
+   },
+   files: {
+     display: 'flex',
+     flexDirection: 'column',
+     gap: '8px',
+   },
+   file: {
+     display: 'flex',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     gap: '8px',
+     color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)',
+     fontSize: '13px',
+   },
+ };

+ // ============================================================================
+ // MAIN APP
+ // ============================================================================
+ function App() {
+   const [appState, setAppState] = useState(STATES.ORB_ONLY);
+   const [selectedRegion, setSelectedRegion] = useState(null);
+   const [canvasContent, setCanvasContent] = useState(null);
+   const [actionChain, setActionChain] = useState([]);
+   const [isOrbHovered, setIsOrbHovered] = useState(false);
+ 
+   // App integrations with spherical icons
+   const appIntegrations = [
+     { name: 'Finder', color: '#3b82f6', icon: IconFolder },
+     { name: 'Figma', color: '#a855f7', letter: 'F' },
+     { name: 'Canva', color: '#22d3ee', letter: 'C' },
+     { name: 'iPhone', color: '#f97316', icon: IconGlobe },
+     { name: 'Notes', color: '#eab308', icon: IconDocument },
+     { name: 'Safari', color: '#3b82f6', icon: IconGlobe },
+     { name: 'Terminal', color: '#22c55e', icon: IconLayers },
+     { name: 'Photos', color: '#ec4899', icon: IconImage },
+   ];
+ 
+   // Quick actions
+   const quickActions = [
+     { id: 'summarize', label: 'Summarize', Icon: IconSparkle },
+     { id: 'translate', label: 'Translate', Icon: IconGlobe },
+     { id: 'extract', label: 'Extract Text', Icon: IconDocument },
+     { id: 'enhance', label: 'Enhance', Icon: IconZap },
+   ];
+ 
+   const handleOrbClick = () =&gt; {
+     if (appState === STATES.ORB_ONLY) {
+       setAppState(STATES.SELECTING);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleSelectionComplete = (region) =&gt; {
+     setSelectedRegion(region);
+     setAppState(STATES.EXPANDED);
+   };
+ 
+   const handleSelectionCancel = () =&gt; {
+     setAppState(STATES.ORB_ONLY);
+   };
+ 
+   const handleClose = () =&gt; {
+     setAppState(STATES.ORB_ONLY);
+     setSelectedRegion(null);
+     setCanvasContent(null);
+   };
+ 
+   const handleDrop = (content) =&gt; {
+     setCanvasContent(content);
+   };
+ 
+   const handleActionClick = (action) =&gt; {
+     const newAction = { ...action, status: 'in_progress', startTime: Date.now() };
+     setActionChain(prev =&gt; [...prev, newAction]);
+     setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+       setActionChain(prev =&gt; prev.map(a =&gt; a.id === action.id ? { ...a, status: 'completed' } : a));
+     }, 1500);
+   };
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     const handleKeyDown = (e) =&gt; {
+       if (e.key === 'Escape') {
+         if (appState === STATES.SELECTING) {
+           setAppState(STATES.ORB_ONLY);
+         } else if (appState === STATES.EXPANDED) {
+           handleClose();
+         }
+       }
+     };
+     window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
+     return () =&gt; window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
+   }, [appState]);
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div style={styles.container}&gt;
+       {/* Background - only visible when expanded */}
+       &lt;AnimatePresence&gt;
+         {appState === STATES.EXPANDED &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;motion.div
+             style={styles.backgroundWrapper}
+             initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
+             animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
+             exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
+           &gt;
+             &lt;FlowingBackground /&gt;
+             &lt;div style={styles.darkOverlay} /&gt;
+           &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/AnimatePresence&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Selection Overlay */}
+       &lt;AnimatePresence&gt;
+         {appState === STATES.SELECTING &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;SelectionOverlay 
+             onComplete={handleSelectionComplete}
+             onCancel={handleSelectionCancel}
+           /&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/AnimatePresence&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Floating Orb - Always visible */}
+       &lt;motion.div 
+         style={{
+           ...styles.orbContainer,
+           ...(appState === STATES.EXPANDED ? styles.orbExpanded : styles.orbFloating),
+         }}
+         initial={{ scale: 0 }}
+         animate={{ scale: 1 }}
+         transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 200 }}
+         onMouseEnter={() =&gt; setIsOrbHovered(true)}
+         onMouseLeave={() =&gt; setIsOrbHovered(false)}
+         onClick={handleOrbClick}
+       &gt;
+         &lt;Canvas
+           camera={{ position: [0, 0, 4], fov: 45 }}
+           gl={{
+             alpha: true,
+             antialias: true,
+             toneMapping: THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping,
+             toneMappingExposure: 1.5,
+           }}
+           style={{ background: 'transparent', cursor: appState === STATES.ORB_ONLY ? 'pointer' : 'default' }}
+           onCreated={({ gl }) =&gt; gl.setClearColor(0x000000, 0)}
+         &gt;
+           &lt;Suspense fallback={&lt;OrbLoader /&gt;}&gt;
+             &lt;HaloOrb isActive={isOrbHovered || appState !== STATES.ORB_ONLY} /&gt;
+           &lt;/Suspense&gt;
+         &lt;/Canvas&gt;
+         
+         {/* Orb hint */}
+         &lt;AnimatePresence&gt;
+           {appState === STATES.ORB_ONLY &amp;&amp; isOrbHovered &amp;&amp; (

+               style={styles.orbHint}
+               initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
+               animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
+               exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}

+               Click to select

+       &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Expanded UI */}
+       &lt;AnimatePresence&gt;
+         {appState === STATES.EXPANDED &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;motion.div
+             style={styles.expandedPanel}
+             initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9, y: 30 }}
+             animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}

+             transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 200, damping: 25 }}

+             &gt;

+                 &lt;span&gt;Selected: {selectedRegion.width}×{selectedRegion.height}px&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;/motion.div&gt;

+                   &lt;AppSphere
+                     key={app.name}
+                     {...app}
+                     onClick={() =&gt; handleActionClick({ id: &#96;send_to_${app.name.toLowerCase()}&#96;, label: &#96;Send to ${app.name}&#96; })}
+                     delay={0.4 + i * 0.05}
+                   /&gt;
+                 ))}
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+ 
+             {/* Quick Actions */}
+             &lt;motion.div style={styles.actionsSection}&gt;
+               &lt;span style={styles.sectionLabel}&gt;Quick Actions&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;div style={styles.actionsGrid}&gt;
+                 {quickActions.map((action, i) =&gt; (
+                   &lt;motion.button
+                     key={action.id}
+                     style={styles.actionButton}
+                     onClick={() =&gt; handleActionClick(action)}
+                     initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
+                     animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
+                     transition={{ delay: 0.6 + i * 0.05 }}
+                     whileHover={{ background: 'rgba(74,222,128,0.15)', borderColor: 'rgba(74,222,128,0.4)' }}
+                     whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}

+           &lt;/motion.div&gt;

+

+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ }

The Tauri build is still compiling (first build takes time). Here's what we've implemented:

## ✅ Completed Updates

### 1. **Orb-First Design**
- App starts with just a floating green orb
- Click orb → triggers selection mode
- After selection → expands to full UI

### 2. **Drop Canvas**
- Central canvas for dropping files/images/text
- Paste from clipboard supported (Cmd+V)
- Shows dropped content preview

### 3. **Spherical App Icons**
- 8 app integrations with colorful spheres:
  - **Finder** (blue)
  - **Figma** (purple) 
  - **Canva** (cyan)
  - **iPhone** (orange)
  - **Notes** (yellow)
  - **Safari** (blue)
  - **Terminal** (green)
  - **Photos** (pink)

### 4. **Green Theme**
- Orb shader: `#4ade80` (bright green)
- Rings/particles: emerald/mint variants
- UI accents: green glow and borders

### 5. **Quick Actions**
- Summarize, Translate, Extract Text, Enhance
- Modern SVG icons (no emojis)

The Tauri build is compiling ~450 Rust crates. First build takes 5-10 minutes, subsequent builds are much faster. Once complete, you'll have a ~10MB `.dmg` at:

```
src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/Cursor Halo_2.0.0_aarch64.dmg
```

---

## ✅ Complete - Premium Neumorphic Design

Here's what we built based on the Pinterest inspiration:

### New Design Components

**1. Neumorphic Circle Buttons** (Source BTN style)
- Inset shadows creating 3D embossed effect
- Inner highlight ring
- Active state with green glow

**2. Neumorphic Pill Buttons** (Upload button style)  
- Soft rounded pill shape
- Top highlight gradient
- Hover shadow expansion

**3. Tilted Glass Cards** (GreenMotive style)
- Fanned/rotated layout (-8°, 0°, +8°)
- Frosted glass with saturation
- Hover: cards level out and lift
- Minimal black icons + labels

**4. Poll-Style Action Cards** (Fusion poll style)
- Green gradient backgrounds
- Progress bars with animation
- Mini avatar stacks
- Percentage indicators

### Interaction Flow
```
[Floating Green Orb] 
     ↓ click
[Selection Mode - drag to select]
     ↓ complete
[Expanded Panel]
  ├─ Version label "CURSOR HALO · V2.0"
  ├─ Drop canvas (neumorphic inset)
  ├─ Tilted app cards (Finder, Figma, Canva)
  ├─ Poll-style quick actions
  └─ Bottom bar (circle + pill buttons)
```

### Color Palette
- Background: Deep green gradient with radial highlights
- Cards: `rgba(255,255,255,0.12)` glass  
- Accents: `#4ade80` (bright green)
- Shadows: Neumorphic inset/outset combo

The Tauri build is still compiling in the background (~450 Rust crates). Once complete, you'll have a production-ready `.dmg` at:

```
src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/Cursor Halo_2.0.0_aarch64.dmg
```

## Proposed Enhanced GlassPanel with More Options

To add reflection, shadow, blur presets, here's an upgraded `GlassPanel.jsx` you can apply:

```jsx:src/components/GlassPanel.jsx
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * GLASS PANEL - Premium Design Library with Full Options
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

// Design tokens for easy customization
export const GLASS_PRESETS = {
  subtle: { blur: 20, opacity: 0.06, borderOpacity: 0.08, shadow: 'sm' },
  medium: { blur: 40, opacity: 0.12, borderOpacity: 0.15, shadow: 'md' },
  heavy: { blur: 60, opacity: 0.18, borderOpacity: 0.2, shadow: 'lg' },
  frosted: { blur: 80, opacity: 0.25, borderOpacity: 0.1, shadow: 'xl' },
};

export const SHADOW_PRESETS = {
  sm: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
  md: '0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',
  lg: '0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)',
  xl: '0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
  glow: (color) => `0 0 40px ${color}40, 0 0 80px ${color}20`,
  inset: 'inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2), inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.05)',
  reflection: `
    0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.15) inset,
    0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1) inset,
    0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05) inset
  `,
};

export const BLUR_PRESETS = {
  none: 0,
  light: 12,
  medium: 24,
  heavy: 48,
  frosted: 80,
  extreme: 120,
};

function GlassPanel({ 
  children, 
  preset = null,
  // Blur options
  blur = 40,
  saturate = 180,
  // Background
  bgOpacity = 0.12,
  bgColor = '255, 255, 255',
  // Border
  borderOpacity = 0.15,
  borderColor = '255, 255, 255',
  borderWidth = 1,
  borderRadius = '24px',
  // Shadows
  shadow = 'md',
  customShadow = null,
  glowColor = 'rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.1)',
  glowIntensity = 60,
  // Reflection
  reflection = true,
  reflectionOpacity = 0.3,
  // Inner effects
  innerGlow = true,
  innerGlowHeight = '40%',
  topHighlight = true,
  // Interaction
  hoverGlow = true,
  hoverScale = false,
  // Layout
  padding = '20px',
  className = '',
  style = {},
  ...props 
}) {
  // Apply preset if provided
  if (preset && GLASS_PRESETS[preset]) {
    const p = GLASS_PRESETS[preset];
    blur = p.blur;
    bgOpacity = p.opacity;
    borderOpacity = p.borderOpacity;
    shadow = p.shadow;
  }

  const shadowValue = customShadow || SHADOW_PRESETS[shadow] || shadow;

  return (
    <motion.div
      className={className}
      style={{
        background: `rgba(${bgColor}, ${bgOpacity})`,
        backdropFilter: `blur(${blur}px) saturate(${saturate}%)`,
        WebkitBackdropFilter: `blur(${blur}px) saturate(${saturate}%)`,
        borderRadius,
        padding,
        border: `${borderWidth}px solid rgba(${borderColor}, ${borderOpacity})`,
        boxShadow: `
          ${shadowValue},
          ${reflection ? SHADOW_PRESETS.reflection : ''}
          ${glowColor ? `, 0 0 ${glowIntensity}px ${glowColor}` : ''}
        `.replace(/,\s*,/g, ',').trim(),
        position: 'relative',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        ...style,
      }}
      whileHover={hoverGlow || hoverScale ? {
        scale: hoverScale ? 1.02 : 1,
        boxShadow: hoverGlow ? `
          ${shadowValue.replace(/rgba\(0,0,0,[\d.]+\)/g, (m) => m.replace(/[\d.]+\)/, (n) => (parseFloat(n) * 1.3) + ')'))},
          ${reflection ? SHADOW_PRESETS.reflection : ''}
          ${glowColor ? `, 0 0 ${glowIntensity * 1.5}px ${glowColor.replace(/[\d.]+\)$/, (m) => (parseFloat(m) * 2) + ')')}` : ''}
        `.replace(/,\s*,/g, ',').trim() : undefined,
      } : {}}
      transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
      {...props}
    >
      {/* Top highlight line */}
      {topHighlight && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: 0, left: '10%', right: '10%', height: '1px',
          background: `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,${reflectionOpacity}), transparent)`,
        }} />
      )}
      
      {/* Inner glow gradient */}
      {innerGlow && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, height: innerGlowHeight,
          background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 0%, transparent 100%)',
          pointerEvents: 'none',
          borderRadius: `${borderRadius} ${borderRadius} 0 0`,
        }} />
      )}
      
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

export default GlassPanel;
```

## Usage Examples

```jsx
// Use presets
<GlassPanel preset="frosted">...</GlassPanel>

// Custom heavy blur with reflection
<GlassPanel 
  blur={80} 
  reflection={true} 
  shadow="xl"
  glowColor="rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.15)"
>...</GlassPanel>

// Neumorphic style
<GlassPanel 
  customShadow={SHADOW_PRESETS.inset}
  bgOpacity={0.05}
  reflection={false}
>...</GlassPanel>
```

+         boxShadow: &#96;0 ${size/4}px ${size/2}px ${colors[2]}50, inset 0 -${size/8}px ${size/4}px ${colors[2]}60, inset 0 ${size/6}px ${size/4}px ${colors[0]}80&#96;,
+       }}&gt;
+         {Icon &amp;&amp; &lt;Icon style={{ width: size * 0.45, height: size * 0.45, color: 'white', filter: 'drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3))' }} /&gt;}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+       {label &amp;&amp; &lt;span style={sphereStyles.label}&gt;{label}&lt;/span&gt;}
+     &lt;/motion.button&gt;
+   );
+ }

| Feature | Options |
|---------|---------|

- function getGreeting() {
-   const hour = new Date().getHours();
-   if (hour &lt; 12) return 'Good morning';
-   if (hour &lt; 17) return 'Good afternoon';
-   return 'Good evening';
- }
- 
- function getFormattedTime() {
-   return new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true });
- }

-   useEffect(() =&gt; {

-   return (

'pointer' : 'default' }} onCreated={({ gl }) =&gt; gl.setClearColor(0x000000, 0)}&gt;

-             
-             {/* Close Button */}

- 
+  * Leveraged from FloatingOrbUltimate100:
+  * - MeshPhysicalMaterial PBR settings
+  * - 4-point professional lighting
+  * - UnrealBloomPass postprocessing concepts
+  * - Sheen, clearcoat, transmission effects
+  * 
+  * Features:
+  * - 3D Neumorphic cards with depth
+  * - GLSL shader backgrounds
+  * - PBR-inspired UI surfaces
+  * - Floating OS widget aesthetics
+  * 
+  * ============================================================================
+  */
+ 
+ import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, Suspense, useMemo } from 'react';
+ import { Canvas, useFrame, extend } from '@react-three/fiber';
+ import { shaderMaterial, Float, Environment, ContactShadows } from '@react-three/drei';
+ import * as THREE from 'three';
+ import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
+ import HaloOrb from './components/HaloOrb';
+ import SelectionOverlay from './components/SelectionOverlay';
+ import {
+   IconFolder, IconSparkle, IconZap, IconClock, IconClose,
+   IconLayers, IconImage, IconGlobe, IconTerminal, IconDocument,
+ } from './components/Icons';
+ 
+ const STATES = { ORB_ONLY: 'orb_only', SELECTING: 'selecting', EXPANDED: 'expanded' };
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // PBR MATERIAL CONFIG (from FloatingOrbUltimate100)
+ // ============================================================================
+ const PBR_CONFIG = {
+   metalness: 0.88,
+   roughness: 0.06,
+   transmission: 0.25,
+   thickness: 0.9,
+   ior: 1.5,
+   clearcoat: 1.0,
+   clearcoatRoughness: 0.05,
+   envMapIntensity: 2.8,
+   reflectivity: 0.95,
+   sheen: 0.7,
+   sheenRoughness: 0.2,
+ };
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // NEUMORPHIC GLSL SHADER MATERIAL
+ // ============================================================================
+ const NeumorphicShaderMaterial = shaderMaterial(
+   {
+     uTime: 0,
+     uColorBase: new THREE.Color('#1a1f1c'),
+     uColorHighlight: new THREE.Color('#2d3830'),
+     uColorShadow: new THREE.Color('#0d100e'),
+     uColorAccent: new THREE.Color('#4ade80'),
+     uDepth: 0.15,
+     uRoughness: 0.3,
+   },
+   // Vertex
+   &#96;
+     varying vec2 vUv;
+     varying vec3 vNormal;
+     varying vec3 vPosition;
+     
+     void main() {
+       vUv = uv;
+       vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
+       vPosition = position;
+       gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
+     }
+   &#96;,
+   // Fragment
+   &#96;
+     uniform float uTime;
+     uniform vec3 uColorBase;
+     uniform vec3 uColorHighlight;
+     uniform vec3 uColorShadow;
+     uniform vec3 uColorAccent;
+     uniform float uDepth;
+     uniform float uRoughness;
+     
+     varying vec2 vUv;
+     varying vec3 vNormal;
+     varying vec3 vPosition;
+     
+     // Noise function
+     float noise(vec2 p) {
+       return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(127.1, 311.7))) * 43758.5453);
+     }
+     
+     void main() {
+       // Base color with subtle gradient
+       vec3 color = mix(uColorBase, uColorHighlight, vUv.y * 0.3);
+       
+       // Neumorphic lighting
+       vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(0.5, 0.8, 0.5));
+       float diffuse = max(dot(vNormal, lightDir), 0.0);
+       
+       // Top highlight (simulates raised edge)
+       float topLight = smoothstep(0.6, 1.0, vNormal.y);
+       color += uColorHighlight * topLight * 0.4;
+       
+       // Bottom shadow (simulates depth)
+       float bottomShadow = smoothstep(0.0, 0.4, 1.0 - vNormal.y);
+       color = mix(color, uColorShadow, bottomShadow * 0.3);
+       
+       // Edge highlight
+       float edgeLight = pow(1.0 - abs(dot(normalize(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)), vNormal)), 2.0);
+       color += uColorHighlight * edgeLight * 0.15;
+       
+       // Subtle noise for texture
+       float n = noise(vUv * 100.0) * 0.02;
+       color += n;
+       
+       // Fresnel rim
+       float fresnel = pow(1.0 - abs(dot(normalize(vPosition), vNormal)), 3.0);
+       color += uColorAccent * fresnel * 0.08;
+       
+       gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 0.95);
+     }
+   &#96;
+ );
+ 
+ extend({ NeumorphicShaderMaterial });
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // 3D NEUMORPHIC CARD (Three.js)
+ // ============================================================================
+ function Neumorphic3DCard({ position = [0, 0, 0], width = 2, height = 1.5, depth = 0.1, children }) {
+   const meshRef = useRef();
+   const materialRef = useRef();
+   
+   useFrame((state) =&gt; {
+     if (materialRef.current) {
+       materialRef.current.uTime = state.clock.elapsedTime;
+     }
+   });
+   
+   return (
+     &lt;Float speed={1} rotationIntensity={0.02} floatIntensity={0.1}&gt;
+       &lt;mesh ref={meshRef} position={position}&gt;
+         &lt;roundedBoxGeometry args={[width, height, depth, 8, 0.05]} /&gt;
+         &lt;neumorphicShaderMaterial ref={materialRef} transparent /&gt;
+       &lt;/mesh&gt;
+     &lt;/Float&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // 3D GLASS SPHERE ICON (PBR Material)
+ // ============================================================================
+ function GlassSphere3D({ position = [0, 0, 0], color = '#4ade80', scale = 0.15, icon: Icon }) {
+   const meshRef = useRef();
+   
+   useFrame((state) =&gt; {
+     if (meshRef.current) {
+       meshRef.current.rotation.y = state.clock.elapsedTime * 0.5;
+     }
+   });
+   
+   return (
+     &lt;group position={position}&gt;
+       {/* Main glass sphere */}
+       &lt;mesh ref={meshRef} scale={scale}&gt;
+         &lt;sphereGeometry args={[1, 64, 64]} /&gt;
+         &lt;meshPhysicalMaterial
+           color={color}
+           metalness={PBR_CONFIG.metalness}
+           roughness={PBR_CONFIG.roughness}
+           transmission={0.3}
+           thickness={PBR_CONFIG.thickness}
+           ior={PBR_CONFIG.ior}
+           clearcoat={PBR_CONFIG.clearcoat}
+           clearcoatRoughness={PBR_CONFIG.clearcoatRoughness}
+           envMapIntensity={PBR_CONFIG.envMapIntensity * 0.5}
+           sheen={PBR_CONFIG.sheen}
+           sheenRoughness={PBR_CONFIG.sheenRoughness}
+           sheenColor={color}
+         /&gt;
+       &lt;/mesh&gt;
+       {/* Inner glow */}
+       &lt;mesh scale={scale * 0.85}&gt;
+         &lt;sphereGeometry args={[1, 32, 32]} /&gt;
+         &lt;meshBasicMaterial color={color} transparent opacity={0.4} /&gt;
+       &lt;/mesh&gt;
+     &lt;/group&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // 3D SCENE CONTENT
+ // ============================================================================
+ function Scene3D({ isExpanded }) {
+   const appSpheres = [
+     { color: '#60a5fa', position: [-0.45, -0.2, 0] },
+     { color: '#a855f7', position: [-0.15, -0.2, 0] },
+     { color: '#4ade80', position: [0.15, -0.2, 0] },
+     { color: '#0ea5e9', position: [0.45, -0.2, 0] },
+   ];
+   
+   return (
+     &lt;&gt;
+       {/* Professional 4-point lighting */}
+       &lt;ambientLight intensity={0.6} /&gt;
+       &lt;directionalLight color="#ffffff" intensity={1.5} position={[5, 3, 5]} /&gt;
+       &lt;pointLight color="#aabbff" intensity={1.0} position={[-6, 2, 4]} /&gt;
+       &lt;pointLight color="#4ade80" intensity={0.8} position={[0, 0, -5]} /&gt;
+       
+       {/* Environment for reflections */}
+       &lt;Environment preset="city" /&gt;
+       
+       {/* Contact shadows for depth */}
+       &lt;ContactShadows position={[0, -1.5, 0]} opacity={0.4} scale={10} blur={2} far={4} /&gt;
+       
+       {/* Main orb */}
+       &lt;HaloOrb isActive={isExpanded} /&gt;
+       
+       {/* App sphere icons (only when expanded) */}
+       {isExpanded &amp;&amp; appSpheres.map((sphere, i) =&gt; (
+         &lt;GlassSphere3D key={i} {...sphere} scale={0.08} /&gt;
+       ))}
+     &lt;/&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // NEUMORPHIC 2D COMPONENTS (Enhanced with 3D feel)
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ function Neumorphic3DButton({ children, icon: Icon, onClick, active = false, size = 48 }) {
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.button
+       onClick={onClick}
+       style={{
+         width: size,
+         height: size,
+         borderRadius: '50%',
+         border: 'none',
+         cursor: 'pointer',
+         background: active 
+           ? &#96;
+             linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(74,222,128,0.15), rgba(34,197,94,0.08)),
+             radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 0%, transparent 50%)
+           &#96;
+           : &#96;
+             linear-gradient(145deg, #1f2623, #151a17),
+             radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 0%, transparent 50%)
+           &#96;,
+         boxShadow: active
+           ? &#96;
+             inset 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3),
+             inset -1px -1px 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.05),
+             0 0 20px rgba(74,222,128,0.2)
+           &#96;
+           : &#96;
+             8px 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.4),
+             -4px -4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.03),
+             inset 1px 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.05),
+             inset -1px -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)
+           &#96;,
+         display: 'flex',
+         alignItems: 'center',
+         justifyContent: 'center',
+         position: 'relative',
+         overflow: 'hidden',
+       }}
+       whileHover={{ 
+         scale: 1.05,
+         boxShadow: &#96;
+           10px 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
+           -5px -5px 15px rgba(255,255,255,0.04),
+           inset 1px 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.08)
+         &#96;,
+       }}
+       whileTap={{ 
+         scale: 0.95,
+         boxShadow: &#96;
+           inset 4px 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4),
+           inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.03)
+         &#96;,
+       }}
+     &gt;
+       {/* Inner highlight */}
+       &lt;div style={{
+         position: 'absolute',
+         top: '10%',
+         left: '15%',
+         width: '30%',
+         height: '20%',
+         background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.12), transparent)',
+         borderRadius: '50%',
+         filter: 'blur(4px)',
+       }} /&gt;
+       {Icon &amp;&amp; &lt;Icon style={{ 
+         width: size * 0.4, 
+         height: size * 0.4, 
+         color: active ? '#4ade80' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)',
+         filter: active ? 'drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(74,222,128,0.5))' : 'none',
+       }} /&gt;}
+       {children}
+     &lt;/motion.button&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ function Neumorphic3DCard2D({ children, style = {}, depth = 'medium' }) {
+   const depthStyles = {
+     shallow: {
+       boxShadow: &#96;
+         4px 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3),
+         -2px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.02),
+         inset 1px 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.03)
+       &#96;,
+     },
+     medium: {
+       boxShadow: &#96;
+         8px 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4),
+         -4px -4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.02),
+         inset 1px 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.04),
+         inset -1px -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)
+       &#96;,
+     },
+     deep: {
+       boxShadow: &#96;
+         12px 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
+         -6px -6px 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.03),
+         inset 2px 2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.05),
+         inset -2px -2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)
+       &#96;,
+     },
+     inset: {
+       boxShadow: &#96;
+         inset 4px 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.4),
+         inset -2px -2px 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.02)
+       &#96;,
+     },
+   };
+   
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.div
+       style={{
+         background: &#96;
+           linear-gradient(145deg, #1c211e, #151917),
+           radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 10%, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 0%, transparent 40%)
+         &#96;,
+         borderRadius: '20px',
+         padding: '16px',
+         border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03)',
+         position: 'relative',
+         overflow: 'hidden',
+         ...depthStyles[depth],
+         ...style,
+       }}
+       initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
+       animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
+       whileHover={{ y: -2 }}
+     &gt;
+       {/* Specular highlight */}
+       &lt;div style={{
+         position: 'absolute',
+         top: 0,
+         left: '10%',
+         right: '10%',
+         height: '1px',
+         background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.1), transparent)',
+       }} /&gt;
+       {/* Inner glow */}
+       &lt;div style={{
+         position: 'absolute',
+         top: 0,
+         left: 0,
+         right: 0,
+         height: '50%',
+         background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 0%, transparent 100%)',
+         pointerEvents: 'none',
+         borderRadius: '20px 20px 0 0',
+       }} /&gt;
+       &lt;div style={{ position: 'relative', zIndex: 1 }}&gt;{children}&lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // MAIN APP
+ // ============================================================================
+ function App() {
+   const [appState, setAppState] = useState(STATES.ORB_ONLY);
+   const [isOrbHovered, setIsOrbHovered] = useState(false);
+   const [activity, setActivity] = useState({ cpu: 34, memory: 67 });
+ 
+   // Simulate activity
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     const interval = setInterval(() =&gt; {
+       setActivity(prev =&gt; ({
+         cpu: Math.round(Math.min(100, Math.max(10, prev.cpu + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8))),
+         memory: Math.round(Math.min(100, Math.max(30, prev.memory + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4))),
+       }));
+     }, 3000);
+     return () =&gt; clearInterval(interval);
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const handleOrbClick = () =&gt; appState === STATES.ORB_ONLY &amp;&amp; setAppState(STATES.SELECTING);
+   const handleSelectionComplete = () =&gt; setAppState(STATES.EXPANDED);
+   const handleClose = () =&gt; setAppState(STATES.ORB_ONLY);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     const handleKey = (e) =&gt; {
+       if (e.key === 'Escape') {
+         if (appState === STATES.SELECTING) setAppState(STATES.ORB_ONLY);
+         else if (appState === STATES.EXPANDED) handleClose();
+       }
+     };
+     window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
+     return () =&gt; window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
+   }, [appState]);
+ 
+   const getGreeting = () =&gt; {
+     const hour = new Date().getHours();
+     if (hour &lt; 12) return 'Good morning';
+     if (hour &lt; 17) return 'Good afternoon';
+     return 'Good evening';
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div style={styles.container}&gt;
+       {/* Full-screen 3D Canvas */}
+       &lt;Canvas
+         camera={{ position: [0, 0, 4], fov: 45 }}
+         gl={{ 
+           alpha: true, 
+           antialias: true, 
+           toneMapping: THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping,
+           toneMappingExposure: 1.5,
+         }}
+         style={{ 
+           position: 'absolute', 
+           top: 0, left: 0, 
+           width: '100%', 
+           height: '100%',
+           background: 'transparent',
+           cursor: appState === STATES.ORB_ONLY ? 'pointer' : 'default',
+         }}
+         onCreated={({ gl }) =&gt; gl.setClearColor(0x000000, 0)}
+         onClick={() =&gt; appState === STATES.ORB_ONLY &amp;&amp; setAppState(STATES.SELECTING)}
+       &gt;
+         &lt;Suspense fallback={null}&gt;
+           &lt;Scene3D isExpanded={appState === STATES.EXPANDED} /&gt;
+         &lt;/Suspense&gt;
+       &lt;/Canvas&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Selection Overlay */}
+       &lt;AnimatePresence&gt;
+         {appState === STATES.SELECTING &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;SelectionOverlay onComplete={handleSelectionComplete} onCancel={() =&gt; setAppState(STATES.ORB_ONLY)} /&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/AnimatePresence&gt;
+ 
+       {/* 2D Neumorphic UI Overlay */}
+       &lt;AnimatePresence&gt;
+         {appState === STATES.EXPANDED &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;motion.div
+             style={styles.uiOverlay}
+             initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
+             animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
+             exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
+           &gt;
+             {/* Main Panel */}
+             &lt;motion.div
+               style={styles.mainPanel}
+               initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9, y: 30 }}
+               animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
+               exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9 }}
+               transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 200 }}
+             &gt;
+               {/* Close button */}
+               &lt;div style={styles.closeWrap}&gt;
+                 &lt;Neumorphic3DButton icon={IconClose} onClick={handleClose} size={32} /&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+               {/* Greeting */}
+               &lt;motion.div style={styles.greeting} initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }}&gt;
+                 &lt;span style={styles.greetingText}&gt;{getGreeting()}&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;span style={styles.timeText}&gt;{new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })}&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+ 
+               {/* Action Spheres Row */}
+               &lt;div style={styles.spheresRow}&gt;
+                 {[
+                   { icon: IconFolder, active: false },
+                   { icon: IconLayers, active: false },
+                   { icon: IconSparkle, active: true },
+                   { icon: IconTerminal, active: false },
+                 ].map((btn, i) =&gt; (
+                   &lt;Neumorphic3DButton key={i} icon={btn.icon} active={btn.active} size={44} /&gt;
+                 ))}
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+               {/* Meeting Card */}
+               &lt;Neumorphic3DCard2D depth="medium" style={{ marginBottom: '12px' }}&gt;
+                 &lt;div style={styles.cardBadge}&gt;Coming Up&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div style={styles.cardTitle}&gt;AI Exploration Sync&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div style={styles.cardMeta}&gt;11:00 - 11:30 · &lt;span style={styles.accent}&gt;in 2 min&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;motion.button
+                   style={styles.joinBtn}
+                   whileHover={{ background: '#4ade80' }}
+                   whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}
+                 &gt;
+                   Join meeting
+                 &lt;/motion.button&gt;
+               &lt;/Neumorphic3DCard2D&gt;
+ 
+               {/* Activity Monitor */}
+               &lt;Neumorphic3DCard2D depth="inset"&gt;
+                 &lt;div style={styles.activityRow}&gt;
+                   &lt;div style={styles.activityItem}&gt;
+                     &lt;div style={styles.activityBar}&gt;
+                       &lt;motion.div 
+                         style={{ ...styles.activityFill, width: &#96;${activity.cpu}%&#96;, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #4ade80, #22c55e)' }}
+                         initial={{ width: 0 }}
+                         animate={{ width: &#96;${activity.cpu}%&#96; }}
+                       /&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;span style={styles.activityLabel}&gt;CPU {activity.cpu}%&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                   &lt;div style={styles.activityDivider} /&gt;
+                   &lt;div style={styles.activityItem}&gt;
+                     &lt;div style={styles.activityBar}&gt;
+                       &lt;motion.div 
+                         style={{ ...styles.activityFill, width: &#96;${activity.memory}%&#96;, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #8b5cf6, #a855f7)' }}
+                         initial={{ width: 0 }}
+                         animate={{ width: &#96;${activity.memory}%&#96; }}
+                       /&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;span style={styles.activityLabel}&gt;RAM {activity.memory}%&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;/Neumorphic3DCard2D&gt;
+             &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+           &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/AnimatePresence&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Hint */}
+       {appState === STATES.ORB_ONLY &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;motion.div
+           style={styles.orbHint}
+           initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
+           animate={{ opacity: 0.6 }}
+         &gt;
+           Click orb to begin
+         &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+       )}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // STYLES
+ // ============================================================================
+ const styles = {
+   container: {
+     width: '100vw',
+     height: '100vh',
+     background: 'linear-gradient(160deg, #141816 0%, #0a0c0b 100%)',
+     position: 'relative',
+     overflow: 'hidden',
+     fontFamily: '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif',
+   },

+     position: 'absolute',
+     top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0,
+     display: 'flex',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     justifyContent: 'center',
+     pointerEvents: 'none',
+   },
+   mainPanel: {
+     width: '320px',
+     maxWidth: '90vw',
+     padding: '20px',
+     background: &#96;
+       linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(28,33,30,0.95), rgba(18,22,20,0.98)),
+       radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 10%, rgba(74,222,128,0.05) 0%, transparent 50%)
+     &#96;,
+     borderRadius: '28px',
+     border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
+     boxShadow: &#96;
+       20px 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
+       -10px -10px 40px rgba(255,255,255,0.01),
+       inset 1px 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.03)
+     &#96;,
+     pointerEvents: 'auto',
+     position: 'relative',
+   },
+   closeWrap: {
+     position: 'absolute',
+     top: '12px',
+     right: '12px',
+   },
+   greeting: {
+     marginBottom: '20px',
+   },
+   greetingText: {
+     display: 'block',
+     fontSize: '24px',
+     fontWeight: 600,
+     color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)',
+     letterSpacing: '-0.5px',
+     textShadow: '0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',
+   },
+   timeText: {
+     fontSize: '13px',
+     color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)',
+   },
+   spheresRow: {
+     display: 'flex',
+     justifyContent: 'center',
+     gap: '16px',
+     marginBottom: '20px',
+   },
+   cardBadge: {
+     fontSize: '9px',
+     fontWeight: 600,
+     color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)',
+     textTransform: 'uppercase',
+     letterSpacing: '1px',
+     marginBottom: '6px',
+   },
+   cardTitle: {
+     fontSize: '15px',
+     fontWeight: 600,
+     color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)',
+     marginBottom: '4px',
+   },
+   cardMeta: {
+     fontSize: '12px',
+     color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)',
+     marginBottom: '14px',
+   },
+   accent: { color: '#4ade80' },
+   joinBtn: {
+     width: '100%',
+     padding: '12px',
+     background: 'rgba(74,222,128,0.15)',
+     border: '1px solid rgba(74,222,128,0.3)',
+     borderRadius: '12px',

## 🎮 Advanced Interactivity & Graphics Features

Here's what we can add to make the app even more immersive:

---

### 1. **Hover Glow & Pulse Effects**
```jsx
// Enhanced orb hover detection
<mesh
  onPointerOver={() => {
    setIsHovered(true);
    document.body.style.cursor = 'pointer';
    // Trigger haptic if available
    navigator.vibrate?.(10);
  }}
  onPointerOut={() => {
    setIsHovered(false);
    document.body.style.cursor = 'default';
  }}
>
  <meshPhysicalMaterial
    emissive={isHovered ? '#4ade80' : '#000000'}
    emissiveIntensity={isHovered ? 0.3 : 0}
  />
</mesh>

// Dynamic glow ring intensity
useFrame(() => {
  ring.material.opacity = isHovered ? 0.8 : 0.4;
  ring.scale.setScalar(isHovered ? 1.1 : 1.0);
});
```

---

### 2. **Right-Click Context Menu**
```jsx
// 3D Right-click handling
<mesh
  onContextMenu={(e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setContextMenu({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, show: true });
  }}
/>

// Context menu component
<AnimatePresence>
  {contextMenu.show && (
    <motion.div
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        left: contextMenu.x,
        top: contextMenu.y,
        background: 'rgba(20,25,22,0.95)',
        borderRadius: '12px',
        boxShadow: '0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
      }}
      initial={{ scale: 0.9, opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
    >
      <MenuItem icon="🎨" label="Change Color" />
      <MenuItem icon="📏" label="Resize" />
      <MenuItem icon="🔄" label="Reset Position" />
    </motion.div>
  )}
</AnimatePresence>
```

---

### 3. **Drag-to-Rotate with Momentum**
```jsx
// Smooth drag rotation with inertia
const velocity = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
const isDragging = useRef(false);

useFrame((state, delta) => {
  if (!isDragging.current) {
    // Apply friction
    velocity.current.x *= 0.95;
    velocity.current.y *= 0.95;
    
    // Apply velocity
    orb.rotation.y += velocity.current.x;
    orb.rotation.x += velocity.current.y;
  }
});

const handleDrag = (e) => {
  velocity.current.x = e.movementX * 0.01;
  velocity.current.y = e.movementY * 0.01;
  orb.rotation.y += velocity.current.x;
  orb.rotation.x += velocity.current.y;
};
```

---

### 4. **Haptic Feedback (Web Vibration API)**
```jsx
const triggerHaptic = (pattern = 'light') => {
  const patterns = {
    light: [10],
    medium: [20, 10, 20],
    heavy: [50],
    success: [10, 50, 10],
    error: [100, 30, 100],
  };
  navigator.vibrate?.(patterns[pattern]);
};

// On button click
<Neumorphic3DButton onClick={() => {
  triggerHaptic('medium');
  handleAction();
}} />
```

---

### 5. **Bloom Intensity on Interaction**
```jsx
// Dynamic bloom using postprocessing
import { EffectComposer, Bloom } from '@react-three/postprocessing';

<EffectComposer>
  <Bloom
    intensity={isActive ? 1.5 : 0.8}
    luminanceThreshold={0.2}
    luminanceSmoothing={0.9}
    radius={0.8}
  />
</EffectComposer>
```

---

### 6. **Spring Physics for UI Elements**
```jsx
import { useSpring, animated } from '@react-spring/three';

// 3D spring animation
const { scale, position } = useSpring({
  scale: isHovered ? 1.1 : 1,
  position: isActive ? [0, 0.5, 0] : [0, 0, 0],
  config: { mass: 1, tension: 280, friction: 60 },
});

<animated.mesh scale={scale} position={position}>
  ...
</animated.mesh>
```

---

### 7. **Mouse Trail Particles**
```jsx
// Particle trail following cursor
const trail = useRef([]);

useFrame((state) => {
  const mouse3D = new THREE.Vector3(
    (mouse.x * 2 - 1) * 2,
    -(mouse.y * 2 - 1) * 2,
    0
  );
  
  trail.current.unshift(mouse3D.clone());
  if (trail.current.length > 20) trail.current.pop();
  
  trail.current.forEach((point, i) => {
    particles[i].position.lerp(point, 0.3);
    particles[i].material.opacity = 1 - i / 20;
  });
});
```

---

### 8. **Sound Effects (Howler.js)**
```jsx
import { Howl } from 'howler';

const sounds = {
  hover: new Howl({ src: ['/sounds/hover.mp3'], volume: 0.3 }),
  click: new Howl({ src: ['/sounds/click.mp3'], volume: 0.5 }),
  success: new Howl({ src: ['/sounds/success.mp3'], volume: 0.4 }),
};

// Play on interaction
<mesh onPointerOver={() => sounds.hover.play()} />
```

---

### 9. **Responsive Resize with Scale**
```jsx
// Auto-scale based on viewport
const { size } = useThree();

useEffect(() => {
  const scale = Math.min(size.width, size.height) / 500;
  group.scale.setScalar(Math.max(0.5, Math.min(1.5, scale)));
}, [size]);
```

---

### 10. **Magnetic Snap to Screen Edges**
```jsx
// Snap to corners when dragging near edges
const snapThreshold = 50;

const handleDragEnd = (e) => {
  const { innerWidth, innerHeight } = window;
  let x = position.x, y = position.y;
  
  if (x < snapThreshold) x = 20;
  if (x > innerWidth - snapThreshold) x = innerWidth - 20;
  if (y < snapThreshold) y = 20;
  if (y > innerHeight - snapThreshold) y = innerHeight - 20;
  
  animateTo({ x, y });
  triggerHaptic('light');
};
```

## 🎮 AAA Quality Graphics Libraries for React

### **Core 3D Rendering**

| Library | Purpose | Quality |
|---------|---------|---------|
| **@react-three/fiber** | React renderer for Three.js | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **@react-three/drei** | Useful helpers (Environment, Float, etc.) | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **@react-three/postprocessing** | Bloom, DOF, SSAO, motion blur | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **three-stdlib** | Additional Three.js utilities | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |

---

### **Post-Processing & Effects**

```bash
npm install @react-three/postprocessing postprocessing
```

| Effect | Visual Impact |
|--------|---------------|
| `Bloom` | Glowing highlights, HDR feel |
| `DepthOfField` | Cinematic focus blur |
| `SSAO` | Ambient occlusion shadows |
| `ChromaticAberration` | RGB fringing at edges |
| `Vignette` | Dark corners, film look |
| `ToneMapping` | HDR color grading |
| `Noise` | Film grain texture |
| `GodRays` | Volumetric light shafts |
| `SSR` | Screen-space reflections |

---

### **Advanced Materials & Shaders**

| Library | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| **lamina** | Layered shader materials (glass, chrome) |
| **three-custom-shader-material** | Extend built-in materials with GLSL |
| **meshline** | Stylized 3D lines |
| **glsl-noise** | Noise functions for shaders |

```bash
npm install lamina @pmndrs/vanilla
```

---

### **Animation Libraries**

| Library | Best For | Performance |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| **@react-spring/three** | Physics-based 3D animations | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **framer-motion-3d** | Declarative 3D animations | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **@theatre/core** | Timeline-based animation studio | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **maath** | Math utilities for smooth lerping | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **use-cannon** | Physics simulation | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |

---

### **Particles & Effects**

| Library | Effect Type |
|---------|-------------|
| **@react-three/rapier** | Physics-based particles |
| **three.quarks** | GPU particle systems |
| **three-nebula** | Advanced particle effects |
| **@react-three/xr** | VR/AR support |

---

### **Environment & Lighting**

| Feature | Library/Tool |
|---------|--------------|
| **HDRI Environments** | `@react-three/drei` Environment preset |
| **Lightformers** | Custom area lights |
| **AccumulativeShadows** | Soft contact shadows |
| **SoftShadows** | PCF soft shadows |
| **CubeCamera** | Real-time reflections |

---

### **UI & 2D Effects**

| Library | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| **@react-spring/web** | Spring physics for 2D |
| **framer-motion** | Declarative animations |
| **react-use-gesture** | Touch/drag gestures |
| **leva** | Beautiful debug panel |
| **@theatre/studio** | Visual animation editor |

---

### **Recommended Stack for AAA Quality**

```bash
# Core
npm install @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei three

# Post-processing (use compatible versions)
npm install @react-three/postprocessing@^2.15 postprocessing

# Animation
npm install @react-spring/three @react-spring/web maath

# Advanced materials
npm install lamina

# Gestures
npm install @use-gesture/react
```
